about: System app slots (parking spots) and the app that fills each by default. Any app that `provides:` a slot can replace the default. null = the spot exists, no default app is published yet.

shell.name: Shell (Wizard UX)
shell.note: wizard-ux + wizard-agent-service as one app (Archimedes is packaging it). Other shells, e.g. hermes-frontend-3, can fill it.
